Responsibilities include installing monitoring systems and applications, reviewing data and dashboards, interpretation and reporting, and responding promptly to unplanned events on site. Comfort collaborating with cross-functional teams, following standardized procedures, and contributing to continuous improvement of monitoring practices. This is a unique company bringing together different disciplines of technology and construction, and has a high growth potential worldwide but at the moment we are being stagnated by a lack of staff able to do all of the above well.

review_candidates.title: CEO Office Manager
review_candidates.location: El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Envision Employment Solutions is currently looking for a CEO Office Manager for one of our partners, a pioneer in development. Job Summary: To ensure the effective and efficient management of the Chief Executive Officer's office by coordinating the CEO's schedule, communications, meetings, priorities, and key deliverables. The role serves as the primary coordination hub between the CEO, the Executive Committee (EXCO), the Board, and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication, timely follow-up, and strict confidentiality. The role manages operational and administrative priorities, monitors the execution of key actions, and facilitates executive coordination, enabling the CEO to focus on high-priority decisions and engagements. The role also supports the CEO across the full scope of his professional and personal responsibilities, as directed. Responsibilities: Executive Calendar & Time Management Own and manage the CEO's calendar, ensuring effective prioritization of meetings, business commitments, site visits, travel, and key engagements. Evaluate, prioritize, and coordinate meeting requests to ensure the CEO's time is aligned with business priorities. Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts while balancing priorities and business needs. Prepare and maintain the CEO's daily, weekly, and monthly agenda, ensuring all meetings are supported with relevant pre-reading materials, briefing notes, presentations, and required documentation. Coordinate executive schedules with EXCO members and key stakeholders to ensure seamless planning and execution of meetings. Monitor changes to the CEO's commitments and communicate updates promptly to all relevant stakeholders. Executive Meetings & Action Management Organize EXCO, Board, and key stakeholders' meetings including scheduling, logistics, venue arrangements, catering, and technology requirements. Prepare, review and distribute meeting agendas in coordination with the CEO, ensuring all supporting documents and presentations are complete and circulated within agreed timelines. Attend meetings as required, accurately record minutes in Arabic or English, and distribute approved minutes within the agreed time. Maintain a centralized action tracker for decisions, commitments, and assigned actions, proactively following up with relevant departments to ensure timely completion. Monitor the implementation of meeting decisions and escalate overdue or high-risk actions to the CEO as appropriate. Maintain organized and confidential records of agendas, minutes, resolutions, and supporting documentation in accordance with record-retention requirements. Correspondence & Communication Serve as the primary point of contact for the CEO Office, professionally managing incoming emails, correspondence, visitors, and communication requests. Draft, review, edit, translate, and format high-quality correspondence, reports, presentations, speeches, memos, letters, and announcements in both Arabic and English. Manage the flow of incoming and outgoing correspondence to the relevant department, ensuring timely routing, tracking, follow-up, and closure of all requests and responses. Review all items submitted for the CEO's attention or approval to ensure completeness — including supporting documents, required approvals, and relevant context — before presentation to the CEO. Where appropriate, use CEO-approved AI tools to support the review of documents submitted for the CEO's approval — checking completeness, consistency, and quality — before presentation, in compliance with confidentiality and data-security requirements. Support the administration of the CEO's professional digital presence (e.g., LinkedIn), including publishing approved content, monitoring messages, and coordinating with Marketing & Communications and appointed agencies, in accordance with the CEO's approval and delegation framework. Ensure that all communications issued from the CEO Office are accurate, professionally presented, and aligned with organizational standards and priorities. Maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive information, executive correspondence, and privileged business matters. Travel & Events Arrangements Plan and coordinate all domestic and international travel arrangements for the CEO, including flights, visas, accommodation, transportation, itineraries, and travel documentation. Prepare comprehensive travel itineraries, briefing packs, meeting schedules, and supporting documentation to ensure the CEO is fully prepared for business travel. Support the planning and execution of executive meetings, corporate events, project launches, Town Halls, leadership off-sites, and other CEO-sponsored events. Coordinate with internal departments and external service providers to ensure all event logistics are delivered efficiently and to the required standard. Prepare and reconcile the CEO's business travel and expense claims in accordance with company policies and Finance requirements. Coordinate the CEO's media engagements, interviews, and public appearances — including scheduling and briefing materials — in liaison with Marketing & Communications and appointed agencies. CEO Office Operations & Coordination Manage the day-to-day operations of the CEO Office, ensuring efficient administrative processes and high service standards. Administer the CEO Office budget, office supplies, and service contracts within delegated authority. Raise purchase requests and coordinate with Procurement and Finance to ensure timely acquisition of CEO Office requirements. Support the onboarding and administrative arrangements for new EXCO members. Maintain organized records, filing systems, and documentation for the CEO Office in accordance with company standards. Confidentiality & Governance Maintain the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive commercial, financial, legal, contractual, strategic, and personnel information. Exercise sound judgment in determining matters requiring the CEO's attention and independently resolve routine operational issues where appropriate. Operate within a delegation-of-authority framework agreed with the CEO, acting on or declining requests on the CEO's behalf only within delegated limits, and escalating all matters beyond those limits to the CEO. Safeguard confidential CEO Office records and ensure secure handling, storage, and distribution of sensitive information. Promote professional standards, integrity, and discretion in all interactions involving the CEO Office. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or related discipline. 6–10 years of progressive experience in executive support, with at least 3 years supporting C-level executives. Demonstrated experience in executive reporting, agenda management, minute-taking, and action tracking. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and professionalism. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken); business-standard drafting in both languages is essential. Advanced command of Microsoft Office 365; Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint. Working familiarity with ERP, document management systems, and Power BI dashboards. Working proficiency with AI productivity tools to support drafting, summarization, and document review. Solid business writing, minute-taking, and report consolidation capability. Benefits: Basic salary Performance bonus tied to achieved KPIs Social insurance coverage Medical insurance: Fully covered through GlobeMed Paid Time Off (PTO)

review_candidates.title: L2 Backup (Networker)
review_candidates.description: Nuestro propósito se centra en comprender y mejorar la forma en que las personas trabajan. Al poner el foco en las experiencias reales de trabajo, ayudamos a cada persona a desarrollar sus habilidades, alcanzar su potencial y realizar un trabajo que realmente tenga sentido. Las personas se transforman cuando aman lo que hacen Esta convicción está en el corazón de nuestra promesa, The Ricoh Promise. Guía la forma en que seleccionamos talento, cómo apoyamos a nuestras personas y cómo trabajamos juntos cada día, creando un entorno en el que puedes crecer, sentirte valorado y marcar la diferencia. Cuando te unes a Ricoh, te animamos a compartir tus ideas, cuestionar cómo se hacen las cosas y colaborar con otras personas para construir algo mejor. Si buscas un lugar donde tu voz sea escuchada, tu desarrollo esté respaldado y tu trabajo tenga un impacto real, en Ricoh te sentirás como en casa. Si te motiva trabajar con tecnologías críticas, asumir nuevos retos y formar parte de un equipo que impulsa la innovación cada día, queremos conocerte. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? Soporte nivel 2 y operarás plataformas de backup con Networker , garantizando su disponibilidad, rendimiento y correcto funcionamiento. Resolverás incidencias y atenderás peticiones técnicas en entornos críticos, realizando tareas de diagnóstico, análisis y resolución remota. Implementarás configuraciones, actualizaciones y tareas de mantenimiento sobre las tecnologías bajo tu responsabilidad. Supervisarás el rendimiento y la capacidad de los sistemas, configurando alertas y aplicando medidas preventivas para minimizar riesgos e interrupciones. Gestionarás accesos, usuarios y permisos, contribuyendo a la seguridad y estabilidad de los entornos administrados. Mantendrás actualizada la documentación técnica, los procedimientos operativos y la información relacionada con las plataformas gestionadas. Colaborarás con otros equipos técnicos para garantizar la continuidad y calidad del servicio. Participarás en el servicio de guardias una vez completado el proceso de formación y conocimiento de los entornos. ¿Qué puedes aportar a Nuestro equipo? Al menos 3 años de experiencia en soporte avanzado y/o administración de tecnologías de backup y/o almacenamiento empresarial. Experiencia con alguna de las siguientes soluciones de backup : Dell, NetWorker, Avamar, Veeam, Commvault o tecnologías equivalentes. Experiencia con plataformas de almacenamiento de fabricantes como Dell, HPE, NetApp, Hitachi o similares. Conocimientos de administración de sistemas, monitorización, gestión de capacidad y resolución de incidencias. Experiencia trabajando en entornos críticos con elevados requisitos de disponibilidad. Capacidad para documentar procedimientos, configuraciones e incidencias de forma clara y estructurada. Nivel de inglés B2 o superior, ya que participarás de llamadas de equipo y cliente en este idioma. Perfil analítico, resolutivo y orientado a la mejora continua. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y comunicarse eficazmente con diferentes interlocutores. Se valorarán certificaciones relacionadas con tecnologías de backup y almacenamiento. A cambio de tu compromiso…. En Ricoh, creemos que el trabajo debe tener sentido, contar con apoyo y hacerte sentir realizado. Para ello, The Ricoh Promise define tu experiencia a través de cuatro pilares que dan forma a nuestra cultura. Love to Connect Formarás parte de una comunidad global basada en la apertura, la inclusión y la colaboración genuina. A través de equipos, países y funciones, encontrarás personas que escuchan, se implican y se apoyan, ayudándote a sentirte valorado y a ser tú mismo cada día. Love to Grow Tu desarrollo es realmente importante para nosotros. Apoyamos tu crecimiento profesional poniendo a tu alcance herramientas y recursos que te ayuden a desarrollar tus habilidades y a mantenerte preparado para el futuro en un entorno en constante cambio. Love to Give Back El propósito forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar. Tendrás oportunidades para marcar la diferencia a través de iniciativas de voluntariado, sostenibilidad y programas comunitarios que reflejan nuestros valores y nuestro compromiso con un impacto positivo. Love to Succeed En Ricoh, el éxito se construye en equipo. Trabajarás en un entorno flexible, con recursos que cuidan el bienestar y un reconocimiento real al trabajo bien hecho, a través de iniciativas como los Imagine. Change. Awards, donde celebramos los logros de las personas. Somos una empresa comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades Creemos que la diversidad de perspectivas nos hace más fuertes. Por eso, nuestras decisiones de selección se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, y trabajamos con un firme compromiso por un proceso justo e inclusivo. Si necesitas alguna adaptación en cualquier fase del proceso de selección, háznoslo saber: estaremos encantados de apoyarte para que puedas mostrar tu mejor versión Listo para “Love what you do”? Aplica ahora y ayúdanos a dar forma a lo que está por venir.

review_candidates.title: Cloud SRE Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description What’s the role? Join our Enterprise and Compute Storage Services team and help deliver secure, reliable and scalable cloud platforms that support critical applications across Westpac. As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, automating deployments and supporting modern application platforms. You'll partner with engineering, architecture and security teams to improve platform performance, reliability and security while enabling teams to adopt DevOps practices and cloud-native technologies. A key part of the role involves supporting Cloud Managed Services (CMS), helping onboard applications into managed support, ensuring environments meet operational and compliance requirements, and providing ongoing support for production workloads. You'll contribute to platform monitoring, incident management, automation, certificate and secrets management, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the developer experience and operational efficiency. This is a permanent role with flexible working arrangements and opportunities to work on large-scale cloud platforms supporting one of Australia's leading banking technology environments. What do I need? Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and a solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and container platforms. Experience building and managing cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, along with automation and CI/CD practices. Knowledge of cloud security, monitoring and operational support, including incident management, observability and production environment troubleshooting. Experience working with Kubernetes, DevOps tooling and modern application delivery practices to support scalable and reliable platforms. Ability to work collaboratively across engineering, architecture and security teams, with strong communication and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting managed cloud services, including application onboarding, operational readiness, platform support and continuous improvement initiatives. Familiarity with enterprise tooling such as ServiceNow, Jenkins, Bitbucket, CyberArk and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Elastic or AppDynamics. Why join us? We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that: Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates! Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave. Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank. Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives. Create your future today To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page , under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section. We may close this job advertisement earlier than the advertised closing date if suitable candidates are identified. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
